display.purpose: Section labels, tab headers, operator navigation. Always uppercase.

title.purpose: Character names and page titles only. The sole serif — signals fiction.

label.purpose: Data field labels (VIT, CA, FUE), condition names, form field names.

body.purpose: Form copy, help text, descriptions. Max 65ch.

mono.purpose: All numeric values: HP, AC, stat scores, dice results. Enforces column alignment.

shadows.name: card-default
shadows.purpose: Present at rest on all card surfaces. Creates tangibility without lifting.

shadows.name: amber-accent
shadows.purpose: Hover state on primary amber buttons.

shadows.name: red-accent
shadows.purpose: Destructive buttons and critical-state interactive elements.

shadows.name: cyan-accent
shadows.purpose: Active/live-state elements requiring extra emphasis beyond the glow.

shadows.name: purple-accent
shadows.purpose: Dice interface elements and d20 highlights only.

shadows.name: cyan-glow
shadows.purpose: Live/active state indicator. Applied alongside arcane-signal color.

shadows.name: amber-focus
shadows.purpose: Focus ring for all interactive controls.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Micro-interactions: button hover, pill activation, icon swap.

motion.name: normal
motion.purpose: Standard state transitions: focus rings, background shifts.

motion.name: spring
motion.purpose: Entrance animations only: card appears, modal opens. Slight overshoot is intentional for entrances — not used on hover/click.

motion.name: hp-width
motion.purpose: HP bar width transition. Smooth deceleration for damage/healing updates.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Cast/Players primary target — phone-width character sheet.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Cast/DM — tablet in landscape at the table.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Stage — operator desktop, multi-panel control surface.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Write-authority action — form submission, confirming a state change. Amber fill signals operator intent.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #c8944a; color: #000; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d4a05c; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0px rgba(200, 148, 74, 0.4); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c8944a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #b07e3a; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action within a surface — cancel, navigate back, dismiss. Disappears into the canvas until needed.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #fff; padding: 8px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c8944a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Irreversible operator action — remove character, reset HP, delete. Scarlet signals danger without consuming space.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: transparent; color: #ff4d6a; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 77, 106, 0.4); border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: rgba(255, 77, 106, 0.08); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0px #ff4d6a; } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff4d6a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card Base
components.description: Base container for character data, session info, and control panels. Barely lifted from canvas.
components.html:
PERSONAJE

Valindra Shadowmantle — Maga de Guerra
components.css: .ds-card { background: #0d0d0d; color: #fff; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); } .ds-card-label { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #c8944a; display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; color: #fff; margin: 0; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Form input for character creation and management. Amber focus ring signals operator write-authority.
components.css: .ds-input-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-input-label { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #c8944a; } .ds-input { background: #1a1a1a; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #333; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #888; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #c8944a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(200, 148, 74, 0.25); }

components.name: Condition Pills
components.description: Character condition indicators. Inactive = muted. Active = semantic color (scarlet for threats, cyan for buffs).
components.html: ParalizadoEnvenenadoBendecido
components.css: .ds-pills { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; } .ds-pill { background: #1a1a1a; color: #888; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 8px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-pill--active { background: #ff4d6a; color: #fff; } .ds-pill--buff { background: rgba(0, 212, 232, 0.15); color: #00d4e8; }

components.name: HP Bar
components.description: Animated HP fill bar. Three semantic gradient states. Pulses at critical. Width transitions smoothly on damage/heal.
components.html: 54 / 75
components.css: .ds-hp-wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-hp-track { flex: 1; background: #333; border-radius: 999px; height: 8px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-hp-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 999px; transition: width 400ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), background 250ms ease; } .ds-hp--healthy { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #15803d, #22c55e); } .ds-hp--injured { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #b45309, #f59e0b); } .ds-hp--critical { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #991b1b, #ff4d6a); animation: ds-hp-pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-hp-value { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; color: #fff; white-space: nowrap; } @keyframes ds-hp-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.6; } }

components.name: Hex-Clip Portrait
components.description: Hexagonal character portrait. The signature geometry of the system — never circular, never rectangular.
components.css: .ds-hex-portrait { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-hex-portrait--sm { width: 48px; height: 48px; } .ds-hex-portrait--md { width: 72px; height: 72px; } .ds-hex-portrait--lg { width: 120px; height: 120px; } .ds-hex-img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; clip-path: polygon(25% 0%, 75% 0%, 100% 50%, 75% 100%, 25% 100%, 0% 50%); }

narrative.overview:
TableRelay is a production control system that never forgets it serves a story. The interface is built like mission control — dense, legible, immediately responsive — wrapped in the grammar of an arcane manuscript. Amber chrome reads like aged brass fittings on a ship's instrument panel. Absolute black is not void but depth: every surface is a lens into the game beneath. The hex-clip geometry is not decorative; it marks the boundary between operator space and character space, every portrait a contained sigil.

The system has three registers in one visual language. Stage (operators) is a cockpit: maximum information density, high-contrast labels, actions that answer without warmup. Cast (players) is a companion: the same data layer, quieter, mobile-first, readable at a glance from a tablet mid-game. Audience (OBS overlays) is pure signal: no chrome, only meaningful data in streaming-optimized layouts, composited over absolute black.

This system explicitly rejects the fantasy-software aesthetic of D&D Beyond and Roll20. It equally rejects the generic SaaS aesthetic of Linear or Notion clones. And it rejects neon-on-black streamer UI — the RGB chaos where everything glows at once and nothing means anything. In this system, glow is a semantic signal, not a decorative style.
keyCharacteristics: Absolute-black canvas (#000000) — OBS transparency-ready on all overlay routes
Amber chrome as structural skeleton, not highlight — present everywhere, never signaling
Pixel-art offset shadows (3–4px, zero blur radius) — tactile without being soft
Hex-clip geometry for all portrait elements — never circular, never rectangular
Cyan glows only on live/active/healing state; red only on damage or critical threat
Spanish localization throughout: VIT, CA, FUE, DES, CON, INT, SAB, CAR

rules.name: The Earned Glow Rule
rules.body: Nothing glows at rest. Cyan glow signals live/active state. Red signals damage or critical threat. Amber is structural — never illuminated. If a glow appears where it does not represent live connection or active damage, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Three-Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber = structure (always present). Cyan = live (when active). Red = threat (when occurring). Purple = dice (when rolling). These four colors carry the entire semantic load. Do not introduce a fifth.

rules.name: The Mono-First Data Rule
rules.body: Every numeric value rendered on screen — HP, AC, spell slots, initiative, dice results — uses JetBrains Mono 700. No exceptions. A number in Space Grotesk or system-ui is a mistake.

rules.name: The Serif Signals Fiction Rule
rules.body: Noto Serif appears in exactly one context: naming characters and page titles. A serif in a button, label, or data field is a design error.

rules.name: The Pixel-Art Shadow Rule
rules.body: Zero blur on all accent shadows. Hard edge, fixed offset, semantic color. box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(...) is not a TableRelay shadow — it signals a different, softer design language.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to interaction state or semantic role. Never apply a shadow to make something pop without a semantic reason.

dos: Do use #000000 as the global canvas — OBS-transparent and the design depends on true black.
Do render all numeric values in JetBrains Mono 700. Columns must align naturally.
Do use Amber Chrome (#c8944a) as structural chrome on every screen — navigation, labels, focus rings.
Do apply Arcane Signal (#00d4e8) only to live/active/healing state. If nothing is live, cyan is absent.
Do use hex-clip geometry for all portrait images: clip-path: polygon(25% 0%, 75% 0%, 100% 50%, 75% 100%, 25% 100%, 0% 50%).
Do use pixel-art offset shadows (0 blur, 3–4px offset, semantic color) as the only shadow form.
Do label all TTRPG fields in Spanish: VIT, CA, FUE, DES, CON, INT, SAB, CAR.
Do respect the HP semantic palette: green = healthy, amber = injured, red = critical.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS aesthetics — neutral-gray surfaces, rounded-everything, Geist font, whitespace overload.
Don't reference D&D Beyond or Roll20 patterns — no parchment imagery, no icon overload, no digital dungeon chrome.
Don't apply neon-on-black streamer UI patterns — no RGB chaos, no glow-everywhere gradients.
Don't use AI slop dashboard patterns — hero metrics, gradient cards, sparklines-as-decoration, glassmorphism.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient).
Don't use Gaussian or soft-blur shadows.
Don't apply glow without a semantic reason — decorative glows negate the signal system.
Don't use circular portrait crops (border-radius: 50%) — every portrait is hex-clipped.
Don't use English for TTRPG field labels on Cast or Audience surfaces.
